sloka: दर्शयन् शब्द वेधित्वम् ताम् रुरोध स सायकैः ।सा रुद्धा बाण जालेन माया बल समन्विता ॥१-२६-२४॥
transliteration: darśayan śabda vedhitvam tām rurodha sa sāyakaiḥ ।sā ruddhā bāṇa jālena māyā bala samanvitā ॥1-26-24॥

translations.english: . Prevented by a multitude of arrows, she with her magical powers, advanced towards Rama and Lakshmanaroaring.
